defects.what: The Bad example still names PriorityMatrixPage, which this change renamed to PrioritiesPage.
DumpFeedInit re-declares entries and nextCursor instead of extending the new DumpFeedPage type.
The adapter's feed parameter hand-writes the action's result shape rather than deriving it, so a changed action return type would not be caught here.
The useMemo around groupTasksByQuadrant is kept although the spike asked to replace the useMemo grouping and the React Compiler already memoizes.
